metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
元3MFの実塗色面と左右面を参照し、全実部品を鏡対応へ改訂しています。初期C/1x基準の不対称は未変更の参考として別に表示します。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
左右対称化のため旧案の格子形状・配色を意図して変更した新revisionです。旧案の形・色が不変という証拠は転用していません。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Original3MF painted surfaces and its intrinsic reflection plane guide this actual paired-part revision. InitialC/1x retain their known asymmetry as unchanged references.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.
This distinct bilateral revision intentionally changes prior cell geometry and paint; old unchanged-shape/color claims are not reused.

assembly_support.method: Paired actual whole-color material roots and reused native footprint supports; intentional symmetric body/color changes are bound separately from their mechanical baseline

observations_ja: 実21,435部品/204型、固定分母17,873・目標21,448との差-13。旧1.2倍案と完成済み3倍対称案を変更せず、別actualIDの実形状/配色として確認した。
正面・斜め・登録正面・放射分解の実Blender4CGと等倍率の左右眼拡大を閲覧。両眼は鏡対応した同じ段付き外形/幅/高さ/位置となっている。粗い格子の段差と照明/斜め遠近差は残り、滑らかな原型そのものや人間の外観採用とは同一視していない。

実保存native sceneの無照明材質マスクでは左右眼各10,652pixels、bounds87x147px、眼mirror XOR0・材質mirror XOR0。全silhouetteには2境界pixelsの差があり、宣言済み1pixel境界距離内である。これを全画面XOR0とは報告していない。実184型/回転BRepペアの両向きcut体積差は全て0で、全実partのpose/色/bijection/involutionも確認した。
初回の実支持検査で不足した下側の同色根元と実荷重部品を、左右対応した実一体の本体受けへ統合した。17支持・全243prefixのnative体積/重心/非reset token検査がPASS、最小公称margin1.556834372mm。単一solid/接点/真の断面/屋根/非干渉/挿入/全先行関係と、元/移動CAD全IDposeも一致した。
必須source支持対象25個は17個の実機械検査部品へ完全対応し、対象の削除で合格にしていない。実外部支台/仮組立支台は0。最大の下部一体部品も個別公称P1S余白内に収まることを検査した。
元の色量子化で生じた、周囲が全て紫かつ同色の接続経路がない孤立した青1cellの左右1対だけは、実周囲材の紫へ明示修正した。形状/黄色眼は変更せず鏡対応を維持し、この色差を意図変更証拠と新baselineへ結合している。全色変更0という旧証拠は転用していない。

observations_en: The actual21,435parts/204types differ by-13 from the fixed21,448target/17,873denominator. The old1.2case and completed symmetric3xpilot remain unchanged.

All four actual Blender views and equal-scale left/right eye crops were inspected. Eye outlines/dimensions/positions now correspond by reflection. Grid stepping and illumination/oblique perspective differences remain; this is not a claim of a smooth original mesh or human appearance selection.

Whole silhouette has2edge pixels differing within the declared1pixel boundary-distance tolerance; it is not falsely called full-imageXOR0. All184actualBRep type/rotation pairs have zero bidirectional cut-volume difference, with fullpart pose/color/bijection/involution.

Measured lower-body failures were corrected by real same-color material unions and actual receiving geometry. All17supports/243native volume-centroid nonreset-token prefixes pass with minimum nominal margin1.556834372mm. Single solids, contacts, sections, roofs, noninterference, insertion, predecessor ordering and original/movedallIDpose are verified.

All25mandatory source support targets map completely into17actual checked physical supports, not deleted requirements. There are zero actual external/temporary assembly aids and individual parts fit the declared nominal P1S margins.

One mirrored pair of isolated single-cell blue sampling islands, surrounded only by purple and without a same-color connection route, was explicitly changed to the surrounding real purple material. Occupancy/yellow eyes and exact reflection remain; the actual color change is bound to its new baseline and intentional-change evidence rather than reusing an unchanged-color claim.

The actual144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter MP4 was decoded at1/18/54/73/108/144 and real support-course frames77-79,111-113,117-119. The first root retains physical bottom16mm/receivingstage20.8mm/step324; display order does not falsify physicalZ.

Saved scene21,435instances/materials/poses/steps and evaluatedframes1/54/72/73/144/1 match, including emptyframe73, fullfinal and exact absolute radial return. All old sources/Mona/Ducky/1x/fixed3xremain intact. Actual PLA/infill mass, retention, strength, dynamic loads and slicer supports remain untested; printing stays on hold.
